findings.evidence: Design spec §IX declares labelled dependencies between the stated units. The render shows four isolated comparison boxes; inline before/after arrow glyphs communicate comparisons, but no labelled dependency links are visible. The defined diagram-arrow marker is unused.
findings.resolution: Author corrected the overly broad plan default to four independent comparisons; no dependency among categories exists.

design_intent_check.note: Author resolved a plan mismatch; all before/after comparisons are visible. No missing semantic element.
